headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Derek Hill leading the Tigers' offense. Aaron Nola pitched 5 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense. The Kansas City Royals fell 5-3 to the Baltimore Orioles, with Samuel Basallo leading the Royals' offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins left-handed pitcher Anthony Banda, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left lat strain. The Athletics' Nick Kurtz has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right thumb capsule sprain. The Pirates' Konnor Griffin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left ring finger sagittal back injury.

The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets acquired RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in a cash deal.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Derek Hill leading the Tigers' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Aaron Nola pitched 5 strong innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 5-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 5-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Suffer Shutout Loss to Reds**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs fell 0-4 to the Cincinnati Reds in a one-sided matchup. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Braxton Ashcraft led the Pirates' pitching effort, while William Contreras and Jake Bauers were among the key contributors for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Twins' Anthony Banda Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins left-handed pitcher Anthony Banda has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left lat strain.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
